notes: Stops the guessing. Settings > Vehicle > Dump CAN getters calls all 64 methods once and saves exactly what each returns - one tap, one file. The decompiled service resolves a signal either by NAME or by profile INDEX, and only seven are name-based: Radar, SendElectricVoltage, SendHeadlight, SendHandbrake, Speed, Track, Turn. Every reading confirmed working on this van so far - the rear parking sensors, battery voltage, headlights - is on that list, and nothing index-based has ever returned a value. If the dump shows every index row at -1, this vehicle's CAN profile does not define those items and no DWM change will produce them. The dashboard now says so instead of showing dashes forever: after a few seconds it counts the signals that were asked for repeatedly and always came back invalid, and shows 'N not on this car' in the top strip. Also worth knowing, and my fault for not saying it sooner: air conditioning is NOT in this interface at all. There is no AC method among the 64 - climate lives in a different vendor app, so it was never going to appear on the dashboard. Send me the dump and the dashboard gets cut down to what your van actually provides.
